events.title: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor corrects its budget announcement
events.text: [SYNTHETIC] CloudHarbor corrected its FY2027 AI infrastructure budget to USD 21 billion, compared with its previously announced USD 20 billion plan. The earlier USD 24 billion figure was an error. No accelerator procurement allocation or market consensus is supplied.
